scripts.dev: docker compose -p mjord-backend up -d && cd supabase/docker && docker compose --env-file .env.dev -p mjord-supabase up -d
scripts.build: docker compose -p mjord-backend build && cd supabase/docker && docker compose --env-file .env.dev -p mjord-supabase build
scripts.down: docker compose -p mjord-backend down && cd supabase/docker && docker compose --env-file .env.dev -p mjord-supabase down
scripts.restart:edge: cd supabase/docker && docker compose --env-file .env.dev -p mjord-supabase restart functions
scripts.git:supabase:pull: cd ../.. && git subtree pull --prefix services/backend/supabase https://github.com/supabase/supabase.git master --squash
